content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison script for the composite-beach benchmark, Case B (H/d=0.2578; title L100; file named BM2_B_Plotter in the sph_comp_beach/case_B directory). Same skeleton as the case_A plotters: loads reference B.mat (L2; t, g4..g10) and model stations sta_0001..sta_0007 into n4..n10 (L4-10); model time /10 and +263.82 s shift (L14-23; commented t=t-263.82 L13); no-op elevation copy loop (L25-33); reference gauges to cm over first 600 samples (L35-43); waterfall offsets +60/+50/+40/+30/+20/+10 cm for pairs 4-9 (L45-61), gauge 10 unshifted (offsets commented L63-64). Overlaid plots measured vs model red (L66-99). Title (L100), axis [268 287 -2 70] (L101, consistent with the 60 cm stacking unlike BM5_tmp_Plotter), labels (L102-103), grid (L104), XTick 270:2:286 (L105). Commented wall-gauge remnants (L108-111). No writes.
entities: script variables: n4..n10 @L4-10, i @L14/L25/L35, g4..g10 (from B.mat, rescaled @L36-42), offsets @L45-61; t from B.mat @L2

equations.ref: model time rescale and shift (n5..n10 L16-21)
reference gauges to cm, first 600 samples (L37-42)
waterfall offsets (+50 L48, +40 L51, +30 L54, +20 L57, +10 L60)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2, @L4-10; length @L14, @L25; plot @L67, @L69, @L72, @L74, @L77, @L79, @L82, @L84, @L87, @L89, @L92, @L94, @L97, @L99; hold on @L68 etc.; title @L100; axis @L101; xlabel @L102; ylabel @L103; grid on @L104; set(gca,'XTick',270:2:286) @L105
unresolved: Filename prefix BM2_ conflicts with the BM5_ prefix used by the case_A scripts of the same benchmark family -- which NTHMP benchmark number this belongs to is not determinable from the file.
Time shift 263.82 s differs from case_A's 265.82 (BM5_A_Plotter) and 261.7 (BM5_tmp_Plotter); the /10 model-time rescale again implies 0.1-s time units in sta_* files.

Model elevations are plotted without unit conversion against cm-converted reference gauges (first 600 samples only, L35-43) -- same unit caveat as the case_A scripts; the no-op copy loop (L25-33) remains.
